subject: Commitment activation timelines, drawdown ownership & VAT evidence
messages:
From: Liam O'Connor <liam@ospreyhealth.com>
To: Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Procurement Team <procurement@ospreyhealth.com>
Date: Tue, 14 Sep 2027 08:42:00 -0700
Subject: Annual prepay & VAT — initial scheduling questions

Jonas / Redwood team,

Thanks again for the demo last week. Procurement is trying to map our fiscal calendar to the commitment drawdown cadence so we can lock in PO and payment timing. A few quick asks to kick this off: 

- Can you confirm the earliest activation date if we sign the order by 9/22?
- What does Redwood require for VAT evidence per country (we're in the US + Ireland entities)?
- Who will be the internal owner for monthly drawdowns / invoice reconciliation (name + email) so we can add them to our AP system?

We're attaching the PO draft for reference.

Attachment: [Osprey_PO_12345.pdf] (see payment terms section)

Goal is to align on the schedule before we route the PO to legal. Appreciate any checklist you can share.

Best,
Liam O'Connor
Head of Procurement
Osprey Health
liam@ospreyhealth.com

--
From: Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwoodinference.com>
To: Liam O'Connor <liam@ospreyhealth.com>
Cc: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Wed, 15 Sep 2027 09:16:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Annual prepay & VAT — initial scheduling questions

Hi Liam — thanks for the PO and the clear asks. High level answers below; Kimberly and I can follow up with a one-page ops checklist you can attach to the PO.

1) Activation date:
- If we receive signed order + PO by 2027-09-22 and payment instruction cleared within our standard bank-window, earliest activation is 2027-10-01.
- If you need the customer trial/live switch earlier we can accommodate a 2027-09-27 soft-activation but that requires same-day payment confirmation.

2) VAT evidence required:
- For US entity: none for inbound payments; we will issue standard invoices per the billing address on the PO.
- For Ireland / EU: we require either a VAT registration number or the local tax representative details to apply reverse-charge (if applicable).
- We'll provide a zipped bundle of our VAT certificates and country-specific invoice samples.

3) Drawdown / invoice ownership:
- Proposed owner for monthly drawdowns and reconciliation: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwoodinference.com> (Finance Ops lead for committed accounts).
- Treasury contact (for wire confirmations): treasury@redwoodinference.com (we will copy once payment is initiated).

Attachments we'll provide: RW_VAT_Certificates.zip, sample invoice template, drawdown_roles_matrix.csv.

Next step: I'll attach the one-page activation timeline and Kimberly will propose the monthly sweep owner matrix. If that works, we can add the docs to the HubSpot deal and route the PO to legal.

Thanks,
Jonas Weber
Head of Strategic Accounts — Redwood Inference
jonas_weber@redwoodinference.com
Phone: +1 415-555-0137

--
From: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwoodinference.com>
To: Liam O'Connor <liam@ospreyhealth.com>, Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Fri, 17 Sep 2027 11:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Annual prepay & VAT — drawdown ownership & ops checklist

Liam / Jonas — looping in a quick operational breakdown so AP can map fields to your system. Happy to be the owner for ongoing reconciliation.

Operational bullets (for Osprey AP):
- Invoice cadence: monthly invoices will be generated on the 1st of each month for that month's committed capacity usage.
- Drawdown trigger: invoices are non-recurring draws against the committed prepay balance; drawdown notifications will be emailed to the primary owner and to finance@ospreyhealth.com.
- Remit details: wire instructions will be included on each invoice. Please confirm which remit entity you will pay (US or Ireland) so we select the correct VAT treatment.
- Evidence deliverables from Redwood (we will upload to shared Drive):
  * RW_VAT_Certificates.zip — contains our registered VAT certificates by country
  * drawdown_roles_matrix.csv — maps Redwood and Osprey owners for each action (invoice, remittance confirmation, dispute)
  * invoice_samples/ — PDF examples for US and EU invoices

Attachment: [drawdown_roles_matrix.csv] (small CSV mapping roles)

Open question for Osprey: do you require advance remittance confirmations (wire MT103) for the activation tranche? If yes, we will add treasury@redwoodinference.com to the notification list.

I'll put the one-page activation timeline in Drive and share the link in HubSpot this afternoon.

Thanks,
Kimberly Park
Finance Operations Lead — Redwood Inference
kimberly_park@redwoodinference.com

--
From: Liam O'Connor <liam@ospreyhealth.com>
To: Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwoodinference.com>, Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Tue, 21 Sep 2027 16:12:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Annual prepay & VAT — drawdown ownership & ops checklist

Kim / Jonas — this is great, thanks. Procurement confirms we will: 

- Route the PO to legal today with the activation date set to 2027-10-01.
- Pay the activation tranche to the US remit entity (will confirm wire within 48 hours of countersignature).
- We do require MT103 remittance confirmation on the activation tranche — please add treasury@redwoodinference.com to that notification.

Please upload the invoice samples and VAT bundle to the Drive link and drop the HubSpot deal link back to me when done. Also: can you send a DocuSign for the order form (we prefer a single-signature flow)?

Attachment received: [Osprey_PO_12345.pdf] (we've added internal reference OSP-PO-2027-09)

I'll expect the HubSpot link + DocuSign by end of day.

Best,
Liam O'Connor
Head of Procurement
Osprey Health
